notes:
Lead profile: small marketplace (vertical: home goods / accessories). Technical contact is Head of Engineering (Priya Kaur). Interested in a self-serve hosted API trial to prototype product Q&A widget and a nightly catalog enrichment job (embeddings).

User pain: current keyword search returns poor results for multi-variant products; manual tagging is high effort. They want automated attribute extraction and an ML-backed Q&A on product pages (short answers + links to SKU).

Requirements summary (from call):
- Workloads: primarily product Q&A (low token length per request), embeddings for semantic search + catalog enrichment, occasional batch reranking for merchandising.
- Latency: aiming for median end-to-end response <200ms on product Q&A in normal traffic; can tolerate 300-400ms during large promotion bursts.
- Throughput: baseline ~20-40 reqs/sec, spikes to ~800-2,000 reqs/sec for flash sales (bursty windows lasting 10-30 minutes).
- Cost sensitivity: high; want guidance on batching/caching and token usage estimates.
- Model preferences: open to small/medium open models (quantized) for cost control; want option to fallback to higher-quality variant if confidence low.
- Routing: prefer hosted single-region (us-east) with smart fallback to another region only if latency or capacity issues.
- Security: SOC2 is sufficient for now; ask about log redaction + short retention; no on-prem requirement.

Quotes / notes from Priya: 'We need answers to load in under 200ms on the product page — customers won't wait.' & 'During campaigns we can see insane traffic spikes; caching + prefix reuse needed.'

Stubs/links: pricing deck (Drive), sample CSV uploaded to Drive, Fireflies transcription available.

Internal: good fit for Hosted API self-serve. Ask Optimize team for quick-run batching suggestions and cost projection for their 2k SKU catalog. Recommend a 14-day trial key + sample wrapper code (JS) for their storefront.
